hints.title: Divisibility Check
hints.text: Check each 1-indexed position i to see whether n is divisible by i.

hints.title: Square and Accumulate
hints.text: When n modulo i equals 0, square nums[i - 1] and add it to the running sum.

hints.title: Index Offsets
hints.text: Ensure proper conversion between 1-based indexing for math and 0-based indexing for array retrieval.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass testing divisibility of n by 1-based index i.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Linear iteration over all n indices runs well within time limits.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correctly map between 1-based problem specifications and 0-based programming arrays.
